added_failures_note: Derived by set difference of failures in the reviewed run baseline_suite and after_suite log case/suite-arms3.log: BASE 12 passed in 5.44s, BASE_EXIT=0; HEAD 12 passed in 5.67s, HEAD_EXIT=0; both completed, no failed ids, so [] minus [] is [] and count 0. These are focused consistency gates for the latest repair against 9063017f6eb4f81aeff26a32847404e6397785aa, not a full-suite comparison against the original reviewed diff base; the head log names the working tree rather than an immutable head SHA.

assertion_audit.test_both_panels_parse_and_name_both_sta: A missing, tiny, malformed, non-SVG or unlabelled panel fails its corresponding assertion; removing a panel citation fails document membership; moving drawing coordinates without updating the independently stored panel digest fails content equality, while volatile date rewrites should remain accepted by the imported owner.
assertion_audit.test_every_container_closes: Dropping a closing section/p/table/figure/pre/tbody/thead/tr tag fails the corresponding opening/closing count; equal counts do not prove arbitrary correct nesting.
assertion_audit.test_every_element_identifier_is_unique: Reintroducing the duplicate nova-fit section/pre id fails the duplicate-set assertion.
assertion_audit.test_every_paragraph_opens_and_closes_in: Reintroducing a nested paragraph, orphan closing tag or unclosed paragraph fails the depth assertions.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_cites_the_check_that_gua: Deleting receipt.json or the new tests/ path from the fragment fails the citation assertions.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_every_state_it_ta: Changing or removing a required formatted state value without updating the independent committed receipt makes the missing-value assertion fail; the check is global text membership and does not bind a value to a particular table cell.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_the_amplitude_tra: A changed pressure/diamagnetic array inconsistent with its separately stored amplitude fails projection equality; missing or altered projected amplitude/percentage text fails the document comparison.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_the_bands_it_meas: Reinstating 0.42 instead of the independently recomputed 0.41 percent fails the expected-string and forbidden-string assertions; deleting the failure wording or claiming all five bands pass fails literal guards; changing raw states enough to cross any stored band threshold fails the numerical inequalities.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_the_control_ratio: Reinstating the old control-current fraction or span ratio in the record fails comparison with values independently recomputed from raw currents/spans; there is no direct assertion that the control departs from the original current by more than 1.5 percent.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_the_nova_fit_it_m: Omitting nominal coefficients, singular values, residuals or state text fails membership; a control receipt reporting convergence or document claiming convergence without the required false string fails the convergence guards; the former incorrect control-target strings are explicitly forbidden.
assertion_audit.test_the_solver_lines_are_quoted_and_the: Deleting either older solver line or all configuration-read language fails, but deleting the new LLS_COND block does not; the latter is the recorded durability finding.

assertion_independence: No assertion compares a runtime result against the same variable the test supplied to that runtime call. The tests primarily compare two independent static artifacts (receipt and fragment), recompute derived quantities from raw receipt state fields, or enforce fragment structure; they do not rerun or guard the physical solvers. The projection and panel digest compare computed results against separately stored values, not the inputs themselves.
call_site_search: git grep at the reviewed head for test_efit_on_nova_rows_receipt and efit-on-nova-rows/receipt.json under nova scripts benchmarks found no production references; the same search under the changed test and fragment returned their real references as a positive control.
figure_review: Rendered both exact-head SVG blobs with ImageMagick to delivery-directory panel-10.png and panel-11.png and inspected both: legends readable, no clipped or colliding text; both maps, axes/null markers and wall visible; no blocking figure finding.

findings.text: The conclusion still attributes the failed 0.148 q95 comparison to solver weighting and says it is not a convention fault, and :97 says the 0.1 target is not recovered, although :84-91 now establishes different surface definitions and gaps of only 0.065/0.064 on matching definitions; reconcile these conclusions with the new evidence and distinguish the unchanged cross-definition gate result from a physical reconstruction error.

The text says the edge-constraint clause is met by a configuration read alone, but the live plan and source done_when require the resolved edge constraint from output or a run log; the record explicitly reports neither, so this acceptance clause needs solver-owned evidence or an explicit coordinator/lead change to the acceptance contract before the node is accepted as complete.

The solver-provenance check asserts only the older DYNAMIC_NDEG/DESIGN_RANK strings and a configuration-read phrase; neither receipt.json nor any added assertion carries LLS_COND or the new single-calculator q95 rows/gaps, so deleting or corrupting the new evidence at fragment :23 and :83-92 leaves this guard green; fold these fields and their checks into efit-on-nova-rows if retained, or record an explicit exemption.
